question:
The product for the following reaction will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c297742b2b2b9bbd090bb210cd73680c16f786f94b856b6253d058e463360f0.png]
solution:
The correct answer is__** CH3COOH.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given reaction is an example of an **oxidation reaction **where an aldehyde is oxidized to a **carboxylic acid**.
 
• The reagent used in this reaction is** KMnO₄ (potassium permanganate)** which acts as an **oxidizing agent**.
 
• **CH3CHO** is the product formed when the **aldehyde group (-CHO)** in the reactant is oxidized to a** carboxylic acid group (-COOH). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Potassium permanganate (KMnO4**) is a strong **oxidizing agent **commonly used in organic chemistry for the** oxidation of alcohols and aldehydes** to carboxylic acids.
 
• **CH₃COOH **is **acetic acid **which is a** carboxylic acid **and can be formed from the **oxidation of an alcohol. **
 
• **CH₃COOCH₃** is **methyl acetate **which is an **ester** and can be formed from the **reaction of acetic acid with methanol.**
 
• **CH₂=CH₂** is** ethene **which is an** alkene **and can be formed from the **dehydrogenation of ethanol. **
